settings.heroHeadline: Giving every child a chance to dream again.
settings.heroSubtext: We provide education, safe shelter, nutritious meals, healthcare, and family support to orphaned and vulnerable children, empowering them to build brighter futures.
settings.aboutText: Siitanest Mother's Love Home is a nonprofit organization dedicated to caring for orphaned and vulnerable children. We provide them with love, education, food, shelter, healthcare, and emotional support in a safe and nurturing environment.
settings.missionText: To provide orphaned and vulnerable children with love, education, shelter, healthcare, and the support they need to build a brighter future.
settings.visionText: A world where every child, regardless of their circumstances, has the chance to grow up safe, educated, and full of hope.
settings.address: Siitanest Mother's Love Home, Jinja, Uganda

stories.name: Grace
stories.quote: When I arrived at Siitanest Mother's Love Home, I had no hope of returning to school. Today, I am preparing for university because people believed in me.
